text:
ashwin: quick micro-standup — drop 3 lines (yesterday / blocker / today)

maria: yesterday: bumped gw routing policy to include /v2 prefix so telemetry aligns
blocker: observed 429s on staging canary under a 250rps burst, traceback points at rate-policy evaluation
today: replaying traffic + trying a short policy tweak to confirm

jon: yesterday: added client-side guard to reduce retry storms
blocker: still see some bursts amplify retries
today: experimenting with backoff + jitter, will push small change if results good

tanvi: CR ping @maria for PR #428 (routing-prefix + unit tests) — left one comment about test fixture cleanup :eyes:

maria: thanks — addressed fixture comment, ready for re-review

sam: quick logistics: can we temporarily bump staging per-key limit to 1k/s for a short repro? would avoid throttling during test
priya: approved for 15m window; applying now:
```
kubectl apply -f infra/policies/staging-rate-1k.yaml
```

deploy-bot: deploy started: gateway-service:v1.24 -> staging at 2090001200
deploy-bot: canary check: startup ok; health probes passing

maria: after load: auth svc started returning 500s during token validation spike — looks like db connection saturation on token store
ash: (note: not in thread) creating ticket for auth DB pool sizing

ashwin: blocker for rollout — @auth-team can you triage token validation latency? even a short runbook (how to roll back/scale) would help

jon: mitigation pushed: client retry backoff 100ms -> 400ms with random jitter (pushed at 2090001299) — should smooth bursts

maria: retesting now with staging cap + backoff; will post results in thread

sam: heads-up re cost: keep me posted if staging stays at 1k/s past 15m so I can estimate spend

ashwin: TL;DR: temporary rate bump to repro, triage auth DB pool, client backoff mitigation in place, CR ready for re-review. thanks everyone — catchups in-thread as we validate :thumbsup:
